**Lateral:** 
Regression compared to CD210, it ping-pongs at slow speeds like off-policy v4, drove over a rumble strip, and the turns on curves are jerky/octagonal. (I'm on Torque Tune v0)
﻿
**Long:** 
* **City:** In the city, it’s the typical OP experience, bad with lights, scared of intersections, slow driving uphill etc. 
* **Highway:** It's speedy Gonzalis without a lead, I feel like it would want to speed forever, easily hit the 105kmh/65mph cruise speed upper bound. Normally, I drive in the right lane because OP tends to drive slow, but with this model I was passing people in the left lane. I was getting worried I could get a speeding ticket. Reminds me of off-policy long but it has less acceleration umph; but with the desire to keep speeding. Had a few cases where it was going so fast, it caught up to a distant lead and had to brake pretty hard for them (I was on aggresive personality)
﻿
**Verdict:** Bad lateral, Speedy long
